note: Every operator request, ledgered with its true status. This is the audit trail the verifier and any future agent work from. Honesty over decoration: a request marked delivered must be visible at the public URL.

requests.deliveredAt: #/admin/missions money plan (4 buckets with purposes) + hourly deposit watching on 4 chains; plan is data the operator controls

requests.request: The daily-update agent is dead for 3 days — it exists in the repo but does not update; probably depended on a dead sandbox
requests.requestHe: הסוכן שהיה אמור לעדכן יומית מת כבר 3 ימים — קיים בריפו אבל לא מעדכן; כנראה תלוי בסנדבוקס אחר שמת
requests.deliveredAt: Root cause measured: the local DB reset with the sandbox while the cloud kept beating (135 attestations at diagnosis). The cloud agents never died. The public site now reads cloud mirrors — a sandbox death changes nothing visible. Evidence: #/network (witness FRESH, heartbeats from mirror.json)

requests.request: Verify everything is alive WITHOUT dependency on the assistant's sandbox — continuity no matter which agent
requests.requestHe: לוודא שהכל חי בלי תלות בסנדבוקס של העוזר — רצף לא משנה מי הסוכן
requests.deliveredAt: The entire public console reads only cloud mirrors + public chains + this bridgehead. Sandbox death = zero visible change. The bridgehead (agent/state.json + handoff.md + this ledger) carries the work across sessions

requests.request: Autonomous push must be safe — so they do not kick us out
requests.requestHe: הדחיפה האוטונומית חייבת להיות בטוחה — שלא יעיפו אותנו
requests.deliveredAt: Six safety laws published at #/admin/missions: rate limits, zero secrets, honest metrics, platform terms first, no custody lies, honest bot identity

requests.request: Do yourself a harsh roast — examine what I asked vs what I actually received
requests.requestHe: תעשה לעצמך roast חריף — בחן מה ביקשתי מול מה שקיבלתי בפועל
requests.deliveredAt: This ledger IS the audit (R01-R10 above show the sandbox-delivery gap pattern); the roast itself was delivered in the operator conversation

requests.request: Establish a sovereign foothold (מאחז) on the Console — your own console there, so you stop getting tangled
requests.requestHe: הקם לך מאחז ריבוני בקונסולה — קונסולה משלך שם, כדי שתפסיק להסתבך
requests.deliveredAt: agent/ directory: state.json (machine state) + handoff.md (resume protocol) + requests.json (this ledger) + limitations.md + verify/ (the measuring harness). The admin area renders it live at #/admin/command

requests.request: Work on the verifying system and train yourself: be more precise, understand more, do not run away from the request; see the limitations and how the network prevents them
requests.requestHe: עבוד על המערכת המאמתת ותאמן את עצמך: לדייק, להבין יותר, לא לברוח מהבקשה; ראה את המגבלות ואיך הרשת מונעת אותן
requests.deliveredAt: agent-verify workflow (every 6h): 15 assertions measure the delivery at the public URL and commit the verdict publicly at #/admin/verify. limitations.md maps each agent weakness to its network prevention. Training loop closed: request → build → network measures → public result

requests.request: Even if I open a new conversation — we return to what we did, the sandbox does not delete the work, continuity no matter which agent
requests.requestHe: גם אם אפתח שיחה חדשה — נחזור למה שעשינו, הסנדבוקס לא ימחוק, יהיה רצף לא משנה מי הסוכן
requests.deliveredAt: The boot sequence in handoff.md §2 restores any new session in 4 commands; the bridgehead + ledger + worklog survive in cloud repos; the requests ledger preserves full context across sessions
